content.name: Chewbaсca and Number
content.description:
Luke Skywalker 给了 Chewbacca 一个整数 $x$。Chewbacca 不擅长处理数字，但他喜欢对数字中的数字进行反转。反转数字 $t$ 是指将其替换为 $9-t$。

请帮助 Chewbacca 通过反转其中的一些（可能为零个）数字，将初始数字 $x$ 转换成可能的最小正整数。所得数字的十进制表示不能以零开头。
content.formatI: 第一行包含一个整数 $x$，$(1 \leq x \leq 10^{18})$——Luke Skywalker 给 Chewbacca 的数字。
content.formatO: 输出 Chewbacca 通过反转某些数字后能得到的最小正整数。所得数字不能有前导零。

en.name: Chewbaсca and Number
en.description:
Luke Skywalker gave Chewbacca an integer number $ x $ . Chewbacca isn't good at numbers but he loves inverting digits in them. Inverting digit $ t $ means replacing it with digit $ 9-t $ .

Help Chewbacca to transform the initial number $ x $ to the minimum possible positive number by inverting some (possibly, zero) digits. The decimal representation of the final number shouldn't start with a zero.
en.formatI: The first line contains a single integer $ x $ $ (1<=x<=10^{18}) $ — the number that Luke Skywalker gave to Chewbacca.
en.formatO: Print the minimum possible positive number that Chewbacca can obtain after inverting some digits. The number shouldn't contain leading zeroes.
